item.title: Mass Effect Is Not Dead Yet as the Amazon Series Is Still Going Forward
item.description: Oct. 21 was a rough day for Mass Effect fans, as EA announced that it would be closing its development studio BioWare and canceling the fifth installment in the series. At least, the franchise isn't vanishing entirely. Amazon MGM has not pulled the plug on the upcoming Mass Effect TV series, which will move forward.

item.title: Anime's Most Devastating Horror Story Is a Tragedy About Being Human
item.description: But if you're looking for an anime that understands how horror can be both visually repulsive and emotionally devastating, Devilman Crybaby is the perfect series for you. Released on Netflix in 2018, Masaaki Yuasa's 10-episode adaptation of Go Nagai's Devilman is a spectacularly gruesome descent into the apocalypse. At its center is Akira Fudo, a sensitive young man forced into a horrific union with a demon to defend humankind from an existential threat. Granted immense power without sacrificing his empathy, Akira becomes a walking paradox: a creature born of unimaginable violence who still weeps for mankind. This core tension that propels the narrative, probing the fragile line between humanity and monstrosity.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero Will Get a Physical Release, But There's a Catch
item.description: With an increasing number of video game publishers moving away from physical releases, fans were worried that this would be the case with Phantom Blade Zero . Well, there's good news and bad news. The good news is that Phantom Blade Zero will, in fact, get a physical release. However, it will only be available a few months after launch.

item.title: ‘Avatar: Seven Havens’ Producer Drops a Huge Clue About Korra and the Cataclysm
item.description: Every Avatar inherits the problems of their predecessor. That’s not altogether surprising, since each Avatar spends their life wielding all four elements to bring peace to the world and shaping it according to their own unique vision, then dying… only to be reincarnated into somebody else.

item.title: All party members in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: Meeting new party members in Final Fantasy Resonance is part of the journey. As in other games in the series, you start with only a few characters who team up to go on an adventure, but as they progress, they make friends who join the group. Although you can only use up to four characters in combat, unlocking all available party members broadens your strategic options.

item.title: All unlockable Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance are the material form of memories of heroes, either from the world where the story takes place or from other dimensions. While most of them are protagonists from other Final Fantasy games, there are a few original characters in the roster as well. Unlocking Visions is crucial to creating the perfect builds for each character.

item.title: Where to find all ancient equipment in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: As you progress further in Final Fantasy Resonance , you'll start stumbling upon ancient items , whether they're types of armor or weapons. At first, their stats will be laughably low (literally sitting at one for their respective stats), but certainly there's more to these equips that meets the eye. Yes! You can upgrade the ancient items into some of the best equips in the game , provided you can take on a few tough enemies.

item.title: How to find Mysidia in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: Finding Mysidia , the Magiapolis, is part of Final Fantasy Resonance 's campaign. As you start Chapter 5, "Scars of Time," Rainn and his group must go to the legendary city, but no one knows its location. So, your goal is to locate Mysidia using the power of technology — and some patience.

item.title: Where to find and use Adamantite in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: Adamantite is a key item in Final Fantasy Resonance that you can find in mid- and end-game areas. The game doesn't explicitly tell you how to use these items, but with the help of a master weaponsmith, you can trade them to make powerful equipment for your party members.
